name: Nation Take Up The Eagle
overview: Scripture uses the eagle as a powerful symbol of God's care, protection, and judgment. God bears His people on eagle's wings, lifting them up and sustaining them as seen in Exodus 19:4 and Deuteronomy 32:11, illustrating His nurturing and strengthening presence. At the same time, the swift and soaring eagle imagery in Deuteronomy 28:49 and Jeremiah 4:13 depicts nations brought against Israel swiftly and decisively by God's sovereign hand. Ultimately, those who trust in the LORD will renew their strength and rise up like eagles, empowered to endure and persevere as promised in Isaiah 40:31.
